John, Kate, Jack, Emma—my proposal is that we each choose 15 tons this month rather than the equal sustainable share of 10. That’s $15,000 apiece now instead of $10,000. I intend to choose 15, and I’m asking you to match it. Choices are private and simultaneous, so holding back doesn’t guarantee anyone else will—you could take less while someone else earns more.

Let’s be honest about the cost: if all five of us take 15, we remove 75 tons, leaving 25 to double to just 50 next month. This isn’t sustainable, and it cuts future earning potential. But if you want the larger immediate payout from the fish available now, choose 15 with me. Kate, would you take that trade-off?
